svg.title: Lambda Benchmark History: Geometric Mean versus Node.js
svg.desc: Line chart of benchmark-session geometric means relative to Node.js from Result1 through Result50, omitting partial Results5 through Result8 and the Node.js v24 Results39-40 from the x-axis; session creation months are shown above the plot. The vertical axis is logarithmic from 0.1x to 100x. Values below 1x are faster than Node.js. Single-MIR sessions before Result16 are assigned to the Lambda typed series, and missing common-engine measurements are gaps.

svg.text: Geometric mean of engine time / Node.js time · lower than 1.0× is faster
Results5–8 were partial tests and are omitted from the x-axis.
Results39–40 are omitted: they were measured against Node.js v24.7.0 (all other sessions use v22.13.0), thus not comparable.
Single-MIR sessions without a typed/untyped split are assigned to Lambda typed. QuickJS joins measured points; dotted Python/Go lines bridge missing sessions.
C2MIR starts at Result18: earlier C2MIR values were Lambda scripts through the transpiler; later values are native C benchmark ports.
R3–4 Python dots include ten Result50 workload fixes; other cells retain March timings. Go R18 used 56 rows.
